title: Duskwood Manor
description: A mod for the custom Wathe map, Duskwood Manor!
body:
# Duskwood Manor

![The mod logo, showing the entrance of Duskwood Manor in a stylised art style, similar to the Harpy's Express logo, rendered in Blender.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06c7ec5385e377dbc3d4bd924472164bbd73a323_0.webp)

This is a mod for the Wathe map Honoured Guests of Duskwood Manor by Somewhat Grand! This mod requires [Wathe](https://modrinth.com/mod/wathe) (and all of its dependencies) to work properly, and will likely **break** if you don't use it on the Duskwood Manor map (and vice versa - the map will break without it!)

Download the map from the GitHub page, [here](http://github.com/undefined06855/Duskwood-Manor) (the Duskwood Manor.zip file). Place the mod into an installation of [The Last Voyage of The Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express) and update Fabric Loader to get started! Walk up to the manor and knock on the knocker to start a game of Murder, or use the `/wathe:start` command to start a game of Hitman.

We recommend the shader [Hysteria Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/hysteria-shaders) for the best experience (though Iris does not come with the default Last Voyage of The Harpy Express modpack by default - you'll have to install the oldest version of Iris and the oldest version of Sodium to get Wathe to work with shaders).

## Features
- Custom text, textures, models and behaviour for Duskwood Manor
- An extra gamemode: Hitman - Each player has a target, and has to try to assassinate them before being assassinated themselves!
